# Neg Papa guest practice general no hedge

In the David Packer interview, SasaVenos says to train iron cross, maltese and victorian twice a week, and front lever a minimum of like three to four times a week, from his own experience. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- Iron cross, maltese, victorian and anything that puts a lot of stress on your tendons: twice a week. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- Front lever: a minimum of like three three to four times a week; front lever responds well to higher frequency. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- "three was it's sweet spot" (speaker of this line is not clear in the transcript). [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- With only two times per week for the front lever you have to do a ton of volume; train the pools [pulls] 15 to 20 reps per session three times per week, four maybe. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (SasaVenos): "i would recommend training iron cross maltese victorian anything that puts a lot of stress on your tendons um twice a week front lever for example i think responds when pull-ups respond very well to higher frequency um yeah that's that's my experience"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (SasaVenos): "well i'll say front lever i think front leave a minimum of like three three to four times a week it really res well i responded extremely well to doing it like very often"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (SasaVenos): "three was it's sweet spot"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (SasaVenos): "i feel like when you do only two times per week for the front lever you really have to do a ton of volume ... train the pools [pulls] 15 to 20 reps per session three times per week four maybe"
